    SELECT DISTINCT

        rev.review_id,
        rev.review_score

FROM refund_reviews
GROUP BY reason_code
ORDER BY reason_code
LIMIT 100;

details.question: 库存低于安全库存的商品，按仓库、区域、品牌统计数量，列出前 20。
details.goldRuntimeSql:
SELECT w.warehouse_name, r.region_name, b.brand_name, COUNT(*) AS low_stock_items
FROM inventory i
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
JOIN product_brand_map pbm ON pbm.product_id = i.product_id AND pbm.is_current
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = pbm.brand_id

details.actualSql:

  r.region_name,
  b.brand_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS product_count
FROM inventory i
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
JOIN product_brand_map pbm ON pbm.product_id = i.product_id AND pbm.is_current
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = pbm.brand_id

GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, r.region_code, r.region_name, b.brand_id, b.brand_name

details.question: 按英文类目和退款原因统计退款笔数与退款金额，列出前 20。
details.goldRuntimeSql:
SELECT t.product_category_name_english, r.reason_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) AS refunds, ROUND(SUM(ri.refund_value), 2) AS amt
FROM refunds r
JOIN refund_items ri ON ri.refund_id = r.refund_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = ri.order_id AND oi.order_item_id = ri.order_item_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY amt DESC LIMIT 20;
details.actualSql:
-- 先按退款单去重类目，避免明细连接放大退款金额
WITH refund_cat AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.refund_id, p.product_category_name
  FROM refunds r
  JOIN refund_items ri ON ri.refund_id = r.refund_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = ri.order_id AND oi.order_item_id = ri.order_item_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT pct.product_category_name_english,
       r.reason_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) AS refund_count,
       ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS refund_amount
FROM refunds r
JOIN refund_cat rc ON rc.refund_id = r.refund_id
JOIN product_category_translation pct ON pct.product_category_name = rc.product_category_name
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY refund_count DESC, refund_amount DESC
LIMIT 20;

details.question: 每个宏观区域下，各会员等级（按等级名称）的商品销售额分别是多少？按销售额从高到低排序。
details.goldRuntimeSql: SELECT r.macro_region, ml.level_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = c.customer_state JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 201
details.actualSql:
SELECT r.macro_region, ml.level_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id
JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = s.seller_state
GROUP BY r.macro_region, ml.level_name
ORDER BY sales DESC
LIMIT 100;

details.question: 每个优惠券活动带来的有效订单数和商品销售额是多少？取前 10。
details.goldRuntimeSql:
SELECT ca.campaign_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cu.order_id) AS used_orders, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS gmv
FROM coupon_usages cu
JOIN coupons cp ON cp.coupon_id = cu.coupon_id
JOIN campaigns ca ON ca.campaign_id = cp.campaign_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = cu.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = cu.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 10;
details.actualSql:
WITH campaign_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.campaign_id, cu.order_id
  FROM coupons c
  JOIN coupon_usages cu ON cu.coupon_id = c.coupon_id
),
order_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS order_sales
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
  ca.campaign_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.order_id) AS valid_orders,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(ot.order_sales, 0)), 2) AS sales
FROM campaign_orders co
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = co.order_id
  AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
JOIN campaigns ca ON ca.campaign_id = co.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN order_totals ot ON ot.order_id = co.order_id
GROUP BY ca.campaign_id, ca.campaign_name
ORDER BY sales DESC
LIMIT 10;
